name: codex
note: Codex CLI rollouts under ~/.codex/sessions (one JSONL per session: session_meta / turn_context / response_item / event_msg). Verified against public rollouts: agentlogs/agentlogs, FankChen/tracecrate, dosu-ai/decant, wibus-wee/huihua. Codex has no is_error field for shell calls, so failures are inferred from the output (Process exited with code N, nested exit_code, payload.is_error). Treat the failure count as a lower bound.

records.errorPattern: \[exit code: [1-9]|Process exited with code [1-9]|^Error:|Traceback \(most recent|command not found
